## Current roles

**Associate Machine Learning Engineer**, Techkey Technology Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu —
November 2026 to present, promoted from Machine Learning Intern (August 2026 to
November 2026). Builds, trains and fine-tunes models in Python with Scikit-learn,
TensorFlow and PyTorch, covering data preprocessing, feature engineering,
hyperparameter tuning and evaluation on accuracy, precision and recall. Fine-tunes
pre-trained models on task-specific datasets and benchmarks each against its
baseline before it is taken forward. Documents datasets and experiment results for
reproducibility, and refactors research prototypes into modular Python reviewed by
senior engineers.

**Freelance Full-Stack Developer**, self-employed, Kathmandu — November 2025 to
present. Built and deployed a point-of-sale system for Raju Bhada Pasal, a retail
business in Nepal, covering product records, billing and sales history behind an
admin interface over a REST API and relational database. Delivered a full-stack web
application for a pest control company in Sydney, Australia, owning requirements,
database schema, API, interface and deployment.

## Projects

- **AgniDrishti Nepal** (2026, final year major project) — AI wildfire prediction
  and early warning system for Nepal. Custom-trained Random Forest and Naive Bayes
  models score wildfire risk from weather, elevation and satellite fire-hotspot
  data, with Vapour Pressure Deficit as an engineered feature. JWT-secured FastAPI
  backend with role-based access, public alerting and automated full-country risk
  scans; React front end with real-time hotspot mapping. Data from NASA FIRMS,
  OpenWeatherMap and Open-Elevation.
- **Raju Bhada Pasal** (2026, client work, live at https://rajubhada.com.np) -
  shopfront and point-of-sale system for a kitchen utensil and household goods
  retailer in Gaighat, Udayapur. The public page is a bilingual shop profile with
  the product range, delivery terms and direct phone and WhatsApp ordering; behind
  a login sits the point-of-sale and inventory management system the shop runs day
  to day. Local SEO built in: geo-tagged for Gaighat, Open Graph and Twitter cards,
  Nepali alongside English.
- **QR-Based Digital Academic System** (2026, winner of TechSprint Hackathon 2026)
  — replaced paper lab submissions at Tribhuvan University. Per-student QR codes
  for instant record access, batch scanning for evaluators, and three role-based
  portals with real-time notifications. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js.
  201+ team commits.
- **SnapSpend** (2025) — financial statement analyzer that extracts, categorizes
  and visualizes transactions from bank statement images and PDFs. Tesseract OCR
  and PyMuPDF for dual-mode extraction, rule-based categorization, Chart.js
  dashboards. Python, Flask, Pandas.
- **Project Ecolog** (2024, winner of Tech Conclave 2024 and technical category
  winner at BPC Hackfest 2024) — Raspberry Pi forest fire and intrusion detection
  pairing real-time audio classification for gunshots and smoke with Azure Custom
  Vision imaging. Azure Blob Storage archives frames; the system triggers hardware
  alerts and streams live data to a web dashboard. Built by a four-person team.
